Name: Lot's Wife
Summary: Lot's wife fled Sodom with her husband, but looked back at the burning city against the warning given, and became a pillar of salt.
KeyStory: Her backward glance at Sodom has stood ever since as a warning about clinging to a life God is calling us out of.
LifeLesson: Looking back at what God rescued us from can cost us the future He is leading us into.
